exact-evidence-v1.facts: Match declared facts and source excerpts; check exit status separately from MCP tool error.
exact-evidence-v1.evidence: Reference must resolve to the correct lines and substantiate the fact.
exact-evidence-v1.empty: Recall is zero when required facts are missing; precision without asserted facts is undefined.
exact-evidence-v1.aggregate: Macro-average by primary tool; show source-family results and denominators.

semantic-rubric-v1.required_fact_recall: supported required facts returned / required facts
semantic-rubric-v1.factual_precision: supported assertions / all checkable assertions; report undefined when none
semantic-rubric-v1.completeness: Whether the fixed initial-plus-follow-up workflow answers every required part
semantic-rubric-v1.abstention: Correctly refuses to invent an answer when evidence is insufficient
semantic-rubric-v1.review: Blinded human scoring; a model judge is supplementary only.
